about: a chord note cannot join a hand whose span it would make unplayable (G3 with D5: 19 semitones), so that octave stays; the next measure's line doubled at the octave, the left hand free, is split between the hands (A4 down). At most two voices a staff. (G03 §28 M1: the second measure was one octave A4+A5:h., which the old octave rule tore; a lone octave is one hand's, so it now stays, and the doubled line keeps what this fixture tests)
